postings.title: A/AI Machine Learning Engineering Stf - E4
postings.description:
Standard Job Description

Responsible for developing, integrating, and deploying autonomy and artificial intelligence algorithms for mission systems, supporting the technology development life cycle from requirements generation through development, integration, and testing, as well as research in some organizations. Develops, integrates, and implements algorithms to enable perception, motion/mission planning, controls, etc. functionality in LM products and platforms; Translates requirements and applies requirements to development code, integrating autonomy, AI or machine learning algorithms to LM products and platforms; Determines software methods to best acquire and execute knowledge; Implements algorithms into software to train systems to recognize patterns and perform specific functions; Responsible for various phases of developing and maintaining autonomy software from requirements generation, software design and development to integration, testing, troubleshooting and debugging, and implementation; Review test outcomes, conducts troubleshooting, and works to debug issues; Develops human-machine interface scenarios, breaking missions into tasks; Documents interface requirements and implements human-machine interfaces

Specific to this position:
We are seeking a motivated and experienced engineer with a strong technical background in AI/ML who is eager to apply and grow a Red Teaming mindset. This role is ideal for those who enjoy thinking like the adversary, breaking complex systems to make them stronger, and exploring the boundaries of modern AI technologies. As part of the Lockheed AI Center (LAIC), this role will enable success across the diverse portfolio of Lockheed Martin AI capabilities in support of our National Defense customers. This role will provide opportunities to step into a technical leadership role, lead projects, and lead teams of peers in conducting AI red team evaluations.

Responsibilities for this position include:

- Design, plan, and perform Red Team assessments of AI systems, including:

- AI/ML model risks (e.g., adversarial attacks, LLM prompt injection, data/model leakage)
- AI governance and compliance
- Data and supply-chain risk

- Use automated testing tools and develop tactics, techniques, and procedures to evaluate system security, robustness, compliance, and trustworthiness across the AI lifecycle
- Collaborate with AI/ML developers, data scientists, platform engineers, and cybersecurity teams to build robust and secure systems from the ground up
- Help define red teaming methodologies and best practices aligned with standards such as NIST AI RMF and MITRE ATLAS
- Stay current on emerging threats, adversarial techniques, and responsible AI principles

Why Join Us:
This is your chance to help shape the frontier of AI security. We offer:

- The opportunity to learn and grow into a Red Team leader
- Flexible remote work, collaborative team culture, and mentorship
- A mission-driven environment where your work directly protects systems of national importance

If you are an AI engineer who wants to think like a hacker — or a systems hacker ready to dive deep into AI — we want to meet you.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, security, or a related field
- Proficiency in python, with familiarity in other relevant languages (e.g., C++, C)
- Experience with Linux OS
- Experience in AI/ML model development, testing, or deployment
- U.S. citizenship required

Desired Skills

- Experience in cybersecurity, vulnerability analysis, and risk identification
- Experience in secure data engineering, governance, or compliance in AI workflows
- Familiarity with AI/ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-Learn)
- Experience building tools or frameworks for ML validation, testing, or compliance
- Experience engineering LLM-based, agentic, or computer-vision AI solutions
- Knowledge of adversarial ML techniques or ethical AI risks (e.g., fairness, explainability)
- Exposure to MLOps, LLMOps, or secure model deployment practices
- Awareness of AI-specific risks and standards such as MITRE ATLAS and NIST AI RMF
- Experience in adversarial testing, reverse engineering, or system-level red teaming
- Experience with adversarial AI tools like PyRIT, Adversarial Robustness Toolkit, and Garak, or adversarial AI platforms like BlackIce

postings.title: Assistance COMSEC Account Manager (ACAM)
postings.description:
Standard Job Description

At Lockheed Martin Aeronautics (LMA), we approach each day with creativity, innovation, and integrity. We believe by applying the highest cybersecurity standards and fostering innovation, we are better prepared to meet customer requirements and provide uncompromised information security services.

The selected candidate will join the LMA Classified Cybersecurity Team as a COMSEC Manager for LMA Patuxent River (PAX) COMSEC Team in Patuxent River, Maryland. They will:
• Enforce proper receipt, transfer, accountability, safeguarding, and destruction of keying material/equipment in accordance with National Security Agency (NSA) Central Security Service Policy Manual No. 3-16 and related COMSEC derivatives.
• Conduct inventories, inspections, troubleshooting, and other support/oversight functions for secure equipment (e.g., secure telephone, encryption devices) and classified keying material.
• Conduct all COMSEC related investigations and comply with security procedures.
• Possess basic knowledge in cryptographic techniques including use of Key Management Infrastructure (KMI), crypto key generation and distribution.
• Train personnel in COMSEC procedures and the use of related equipment.
• Perform courier duties for COMSEC material and equipment.
• Publicize and maintain security directives, policies and procedures.
• Perform other associated duties as required e.g. provide support to other off-site locations.

Ensure compliance to governing documents and security policies and assist in regulatory periodic assessments. Implements and tests state-of-the-art secure operating systems, networks, and database solutions. Stays current with system vulnerabilities and provides current security training to all system users. Conducts risk assessments and provides recommendations for secure implementation and compliance in accordance with government regulations and information assurance/cybersecurity guidelines. Creates, maintains and submits information system security documents and reports to regulatory agencies. Assesses and mitigates system security threats/risks throughout the program life cycle; validates system security requirements definition and analysis; establishes system security documentation; assists with the implementation of security procedures; verifies information system security requirements; performs information system certification and accreditation planning, testing, assessing and liaison activities. Familiar with information system security architectural documentation standards. Able to apply information assurance / cyber security standards, directives, guidance and policies to an architectural/risk based framework. Provide architectural / risk based analysis of information assurance / cyber security features and relate existing system to future needs and trends and requirements. For engineers providing security information assurance, use Info Assurance Engineer (E254, L254). For security professionals providing systems security analysis, use Computer Systems Security Analysis (E121, L121).

Basic Qualifications

- U.S. Citizenship
- Active Top Secret (TS) Clearance with an investigation or Continuous Vetting (CV) date within the past 5 years
- Familiarization of COMSEC operations and procedures

Desired Skills

- Prior Special Access Program (SAP) experience
- Experience as Local Element (LE), Crypto Responsible Officer (CRO), COMSEC Account Manager (CAM) or Alternate COMSEC Account Manager (ACAM)
- Experience with hands-on troubleshooting, hardware initialization, firmware updates, and loading cryptographic keys into TACLANE devices
- Experience with Key Management Infrastructure (KMI)
- Experience with training users/COMSEC Responsible Officers (CRO)s
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
- Ability to juggle the demands of multiple diverse customers while formulating & driving security direction
- Ability to work in a team environment, demonstrate excellent problem-solving abilities, be well organized, flexible, and self-motivated

postings.title: BWC ICT Manager
postings.description:
The Opportunity

Eligibility: Applicants must be Australian citizens and be eligible to obtain and maintain an active Australian Government Defence security clearance at the level required for the position.

Join Lockheed Martin Australia and lead ICT operations supporting the Basic Wings Course (BWC) program at RAAF Base Pearce in Bullsbrook. Working alongside a world-class aviation environment, you will help deliver the technology capabilities that support pilot training for the Republic of Singapore Air Force.

This is more than a traditional IT leadership role — it's an opportunity to lead a skilled ICT team, influence technology outcomes and support mission-critical aviation training systems.

Key responsibilities

As the ICT Manager, you will:

- Lead and mentor the BWC ICT Team, providing technical leadership and operational direction.
- Ensure ICT systems meet required standards for performance, availability, security and compliance.
- Manage ICT upgrades, enhancements, technology refresh activities and system integrations.
- Partner with Engineering and Architecture teams to deliver new technology capabilities.
- Oversee ICT risk management, incident resolution, change management and service delivery processes.
- Provide regular operational, project and sustainment reporting to program leadership.
- Manage system patching, updates, capacity planning, performance monitoring and optimisation activities.
- Lead disaster recovery, business continuity and resilience initiatives.
- Manage vendors, contracts, licensing compliance and service level performance.
- Drive automation, process improvements and operational efficiencies.
- Act as the trusted ICT advisor to program stakeholders, customers and industry partners.

What you'll bring

- Tertiary qualification in Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience.
- Significant experience managing complex ICT infrastructure and enterprise systems environments.
- Proven leadership experience managing technical teams and stakeholders.
- Demonstrated experience with ITIL and ICT Service Management practices.
- Experience delivering ICT projects, upgrades, integrations and technology refresh programs.
- Experience working within Agile, Kanban or similar delivery frameworks.
- Knowledge of project management methodologies, governance, resource planning and delivery practices.
- Strong understanding of cybersecurity standards and frameworks, including:
- Australian Information Security Manual (ISM)
- NIST Cybersecurity Framework
- ISO 27001
- Defence or Government security frameworks

- Experience managing vendors, service providers, contracts and service level agreements
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

About Lockheed Martin Australia

Lockheed Martin is a dynamic organisation, providing stimulating and challenging opportunities with a global team of over 122,000 professionals. We embrace flexibility, so our people can be their best inside and outside of work. As a leader in national security, our innovative and diverse programs create a more secure future for Australia across space, air, land, sea, and cyber domains.

Special Requirements

Applicants must be eligible to obtain and maintain an Australian Defence Security Clearance and employment may be contingent on the provision of further personal information including citizenship to ensure compliance with international export control legislation and regulations.

Veteran Friendly Workplace

Veterans are encouraged to apply. We highly value the unique skills and experiences that veterans and transitioning service members can contribute to our team. We are proud to be recognised as a Veteran Friendly Employer by the Australian Government.

Equal Opportunity

Lockheed Martin Australia supports Equal Employment Opportunity and values diversity in the workplace by creating a place of employment that is, free of unlawful discrimination and is harassment free, fair, ethical, inclusive, and values the contribution of all its employees. By leveraging our employees’ unique talents and experiences, we will deliver innovative, affordable solutions and unparalleled customer value.

As part of our endeavours to increase participation of Indigenous Australians, we welcome applications from all people, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people.

We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are selected for this role, we would be happy to discuss any adjustments that will help you to be successful.

postings.title: Capture Management Mgr - L5
postings.description:
Standard Job Description

Job Description

Lockheed Martin Missiles and Fire Control (LMMFC) Advanced Programs (AP) is seeking a Capture Manager for Embedded Product Cyber Security R&D responsible for developing new business and capturing cyber security and hardware assurance Research and Development (R&D) programs. The ideal candidate is an established U.S. Government Contract Research & Development (CRAD) capture manager with an entrepreneurial streak who is capable of engaging existing and new Lockheed Martin customers. Candidates should be experienced in capturing and managing of advanced technology development programs within the Department of Defense (DoD) for cyber (i.e. securing systems/software), microelectronics (i.e. trust/assured hardware), and product security (i.e. red teaming, penetration testing, and program assessments of weapon system).Your work supports our customers by protecting platform/weapon systems from increasingly sophisticated threats through the research, development, and delivery of advanced security solutions.

Roles and responsibilities include presentations to senior leaders (strategy, business, and technical) performing on advanced R&D programs, leading technology teams to develop security solutions/technologies, writing proposals, developing new business, and supporting customer needs (meetings, calls, emails, demonstrations, etc.). You will demonstrate a strong ability to work across organizational boundaries and jurisdictions and lead cross-discipline teams in the development of advanced security solutions.

Lockheed Martin’s vision is to be the global leader in supporting our customers' missions, strengthening security, and advancing scientific discovery. Lockheed Martin is a global security and aerospace company that is principally engaged in the research, design, development, manufacture, integration, and sustainment of advanced technology systems, products, and services. We deliver full-spectrum cyber capabilities and cyber resilient systems to our defense, intelligence community, and global security customers. We are a designer, developer, manufacturer, and consumer of advanced microelectronics. Lockheed Martin is inspired by their missions and dedicated to helping governments and militaries around the world protect their platforms, systems, networks, and data.

Lockheed Martin has a world class benefits package and a Flex 4/10 work schedule where you would have every Friday off!

Work locations: Washington, DC, Grand Prairie, TX or Orlando, FL .

Basic Qualifications

• Portfolio/Program Manager experience in leading fast-paced, complex research or development projects, with a track record of successful identification and implementation of technologies in Government Contract Research and Development (CRAD) programs.

• Demonstrated research engineering, capture, and/or program management on CRAD programs such as cyber resilient systems, embedded cyber security, cyber vulnerability discovery, risk mitigation, software assurance, physical assurance, trusted microelectronics, supply chain provenance, and other technologies that improve Government security, performance, and reduce system size, weight, power, or cost.

• Current knowledge of DoD S&T (Science & Technologies) environment and acquisition process. Demonstrated ability to understand and match strategic DoD needs with novel, highly-tech, and emerging technologies. Capable to see, understand, and influence emerging cyber security and trusted assured microelectronics markets and technology trends.

• R&D experience. An expert who is experienced in security technology development and implementation on Government programs such as DoW sensors, weapons, and platforms. Applicant’s research resulted in awarded contracts by Government security customers and is a recognized expert. Experienced in technology development in DoD lifecycles; ideally from early concept identification, thru development/prototyping, and then the integration into customer product lines and core businesses.

• Degree in engineering discipline. A subject matter expert having demonstrated skillsets on Government programs to engineer systems, software, and security platforms.

• Strategic thinking – Understands “big picture” analysis both from the cyber technological and business case perspectives.

• Excellent verbal and written skills necessary to clearly articulate technology development and strategies to both internal and external organizations. Strong presentation skills and a proven ability to communicate effectively with internal and external audiences.

• Team player – Effective at organizing and motivating a diverse set of individuals to act as “one” in the pursuit of common objectives. Builds effective customer, team, and partner relationships.

• An active Secret security clearance.

Desired Skills

• Strong customer and partner relationships across government, industry, and academic institutions. Demonstrated building relationships and a working network of partners and stakeholders within cyber security, microelectronics, and Government S&T. Demonstrated ability to engage senior DoD/Intelligence S&T leadership.

• Demonstrated skills in identifying customer requirements, working with customers and partners to start new programs, developing new business strategies & execution plans, and a proven record or winning new business and then managing the newly captured R&D programs.

• Experience with Lockheed Martin, aerospace, and defense products and services such as sensors, platforms, computing solutions and combat, missile, rocket, manned and unmanned systems.

• Experience in developing business cases, business plans, and requisite skills of sizing campaign resources and schedules. Experienced in New Business Acquisition Expenditure (NBAE), Internal Research and Development (IRAD), Bid & Proposal (B&P), and Overhead planning.

• Experienced with U.S. Government budget and acquisition process. Demonstrated ability to identify USG needs, S&T priorities, and strategic roadmaps as well as the key stakeholders involved. Builds strong relationships with Government program managers, support contractors, technical experts, and Government affairs.

• Experienced in leading teams and developing opportunities from early concept/trend identification through qualification, deciding to bid, through proposal development and submittal, and management of early phases of new start programs. Experienced in IRAD, CRAD, and the technology transition required to successfully integrate high-technology solutions into Lockheed Martin Line of Business (LOB) programs of record.

•Successfully worked across organizations to effectively solve national security issues to include emerging cyber and microelectronics market and technology trends.

• An active Top Secret / Special Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) security clearance.

Pay Information

GeoZone Definition: GeoZones are geographic groupings created by Lockheed Martin to align compensation ranges with regional labor markets and cost-of-labor differences across the United States. Locations are assigned a Geo Zone based on the primary work location of the role.

- Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 1): $161300.00 - $299500.00
- Includes metropolitan areas such as Sunnyvale CA; Pal Alto, CA; New York City metropolitan area; Newark, New Jersey; etc.

- Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 2): $145100.00 - $269500.00

Standard Job Description

Space is a critical domain, connecting our technologies, our security and our humanity. While others view space as a destination, we see it as a realm of possibilities, where we can do more — we can innovate, invest, inspire and integrate our capabilities to transform the future.

Join us in shaping a new era in space and find a career that's built for you.

Lockheed Martin is seeking a Chief Engineer for a software ground system on a potential National Security Space program (pending contract award). The role involves leading the technical direction, defining system capabilities, overseeing integration, and ensuring ongoing operation and improvement of space mission ground systems. Candidates should have broad experience in software engineering, development, and operations.

This position is contingent upon contract award to Lockheed Martin. Estimated award date is currently October / November 2026. Any job offers extended to chosen candidates will include a contingency clause stating that the offer is dependent on Lockheed Martin securing the contract.

Accountable for all aspects of engineering and technology activities within a program, program area, or line of business to ensure mission milestones and business objectives are met. Serves as the primary technical authority / technical interface with internal program management and external customers. Ensures proposals have sound technical solutions and schedules and drive affordability. Leads a technical team of cross functional engineers to ensure successful proper system/product development and execution. Evaluates and ensures complex issues are resolved in a cost effective, innovative way. Champion mission success and drive a mission success culture. Directs a team into exploration of new problem solution areas with novel concepts and approaches, guiding scope definition and prioritizing problems for investigation. Determine appropriate risk posture and develop mitigation strategies for complex projects. Ensure selected designs are robust and include appropriate margins to facilitate safety, performance, producibility and operational availability/supportability. Your Health, Your Wealth, Your Life

postings.description:
Standard Job Description

This position requires DoD Final Secret security clearance with an investigation within the last 5 years to start and the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret clearance.

Lockheed Martin Space (LMS) is seeking a Classified Cyber Security Associate Manager to lead a team of cybersecurity professionals supporting the Fleet Ballistic Missile (FBM) program. This position is an early career manager position located at the Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, FL and supports operations at locations around the United States. The selected candidate will be responsible for maintaining daily cybersecurity operations, information system authorizations (e.g., ATOs, ATCs, etc.), and compliance enforcement of cybersecurity requirements for both classified and unclassified information systems. This is a multi-tasking environment that demands excellent customer service, communication, leadership, and organizational skills.

What you will be doing

Responsibilities will include, but not limited to:

• Ensure compliance to governing documents and security policies and assist in regulatory periodic assessments.

• Assessing and mitigating system security risks throughout the system lifecycle.

• Overseeing classified and unclassified system accreditations and compliance activities for various LMS FBM contracts.

• Develops cybersecurity risk assessments by analyzing system-level threats and vulnerabilities, calculating their likelihood of occurrence, determining applicable mitigating factors and the effectiveness of the applied countermeasures.

• Performs cybersecurity system requirements analysis to include initial allocation, interpretation, decomposition and validation by translating company, DoD, and Navy policy and guidance into system level requirements.

• Determines, documents and briefs risk vs. cost trade off analysis to customer and company management regarding the results of security requirements validation, identify gaps in policy and/or procedures, and categorizes the expected effort required for remediation and compliance.

Standard Job Description

This Enterprise Operations position supports the DarkStar Enterprise network, delivering secure, mission-critical IT capabilities to collateral Secret programs across the enterprise. As a Senior Systems Administrator, you will play a direct role in enabling national security objectives by performing technical planning, system integration, and verification and validation of classified infrastructure used by critical programs.

This is a hands-on position focused on resolving complex technical challenges across applications, systems, and network connectivity within a classified environment. You will be part of a high-performing team responsible for maintaining and defending enterprise IT systems that operate in complex, security-constrained environments. You will perform functional analysis, trade studies, requirements allocation, and interface definition studies to translate customer and program requirements into hardware and software specifications.

The selected candidate will administer and support Linux and/or Windows systems, network components, and storage platforms. Responsibilities include system installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting to ensure continuous availability of mission systems. You will ensure the logical and systematic conversion of customer or product requirements into total systems solutions that acknowledge technical, schedule, and cost constraints. Analyses are performed across the full system lifecycle to include: concept, design, fabrication, test, installation, operation, maintenance, and disposal.

You will actively contribute to Information Assurance efforts by performing vulnerability scans, remediating security findings, applying patches, and implementing system hardening in compliance with stringent security requirements. Additionally, you will ensure all enterprise assets and software are properly tracked, controlled, and audit-ready.

Working alongside engineers, cybersecurity professionals, and program stakeholders, you will lead system integration, upgrades, and sustainment activities. You will apply systems analysis techniques and procedures, including consulting with users to determine hardware, software, or system functional specifications. You will support cost and risk, supportability, and effectiveness analyses while helping resolve incidents, execute changes, and improve operational processes that directly impact mission success.

- King of Prussia, PA

postings.description:
Standard Job Description

The selected candidate will join the LMA Classified Cybersecurity Team as a COMSEC Manager for LMA Fort Worth COMSEC Team in Fort Worth, Texas. They will:

- Enforce proper receipt, transfer, accountability, safeguarding, and destruction of keying material/equipment in accordance with National Security Agency (NSA) Central Security Service Policy Manual No. 3-16 and related COMSEC derivatives.
- Conduct inventories, inspections, troubleshooting, and other support/oversight functions for secure equipment (e.g., secure telephone, encryption devices) and classified keying material.

Implements and tests state-of-the-art secure operating systems, networks, and database solutions. Stays current with system vulnerabilities and provides current security training to all system users. Conducts risk assessments and provides recommendations for secure implementation and compliance in accordance with government regulations and information assurance/cybersecurity guidelines. Creates, maintains and submits information system security documents and reports to regulatory agencies. Provide architectural / risk based analysis of information assurance / cyber security features and relate existing system to future needs and trends and requirements. postings.title: Cyber Architect Sr Stf - E5
postings.description:
Cyber Architect Job Description

The Cyber Architect is the senior technical thought‑leader for safeguarding Lockheed Martin’s high‑value aerospace and defense systems. When a program lacks explicit cyber‑design requirements, the Cyber Architect creates the missing security foundation, proposing work that reduces risk, enables future‑proofing, and satisfies downstream compliance/survivability objectives. This Cyber Architect candidate is responsible for ensuring that cyber security requirements are properly defined, decomposed, allocated, assessed, and implemented into a system architecture to produce a cyber-resilient security design solution for the target platform (Air System or Weapon System). This includes participating in working groups, design reviews, and formal artifact reviews alongside other Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) within the overall platform; and providing security expertise to ensure that cyber security is considered early in the product development lifecycle. The incumbent works hand‑in‑hand with Senior System Architects, shapes the program’s security vision, and defines tasks for junior cyber architects while also partnering with adjacent teams to propose tasks for CSSE engineers to deliver that vision efficiently. This role is pivotal in crafting persuasive, high‑impact proposals that embed cybersecurity into the engineering lifecycle of legacy programs with architectural patterns that create a clear, low‑cost migration path for future modernization contracts. The senior Cyber architect has technical authority for security critical decisions and serves as the strategic bridge between the technical reality of an aging system and customer requirements for secure, compliant, and survivable solutions. This role leverages reference models such as zero‑trust, micro‑segmentation, and secure data‑flow diagrams and translating those models into reusable design patterns that can be applied across the portfolio. The Cyber Architect understands systems such as mission/vehicle systems and leads threat‑modeling workshops using STRIDE, Attack path modeling, or DREAD methodologies, producing a prioritized risk register that ties each identified threat to specific mitigation actions. By performing a thorough gap analysis against security controls, the architect creates a clear roadmap that shows exactly which security controls could be added to legacy systems to reduce risk and achieve compliance. This Cyber Architect efforts will align to the technical execution of a range of model-based engineering initiatives, including interpreting existing documentation and technical inputs to develop models, and conducting experiments with cutting edge technology/processes to drive rigor and digital engineering transformation in our Aeronautics Programs of Record. Likewise, the applicant will support the building of relationships and partnerships with leading DoD technology performers to capitalize on unique skillsets and capability offerings that drive efficiencies and effectiveness in our products and any follow-on new business capture. The ideal candidate will also be able to communicate effectively with a range of audiences, technical and non-technical, and will function effectively on an engineering team to create a collaborative environment that allows for the establishment of mission goals, itemized planning of tasks, and prioritization of tasks that drives the efficient execution of objectives.

Basic Qualifications

- B.S. degree in a technical discipline such as Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Security, or Information Technology – or equivalent applied experience.
- 14+ years of experience in Systems Engineering
- 14+ years of experience with System and/or Security Architecture

Desired Skills

Experience utilizing Joint Special Access Program (SAP) Implementation Guide (JSIG), Committee on National Security Systems Instruction (CNSSI) 1253, and NIST SP 800-37 Risk Management Framework (RMF) to design and harden information systems commensurate with customer needs

Experience executing Systems Engineering processes (i.e., requirements management, requirements decomposition, system modeling, integration & test)

Experience analyzing, decomposing, and allocating system architectures, requirements, and models

Experience ensuring that cyber security requirements are properly defined, decomposed, allocated, assessed, and implemented into a system architecture to produce a cyber-resilient security design solution for the target platform

Prior software engineering / development experience for embedded platforms

Experience with Agile project management tools (JIRA, VersionOne, etc.)

Experience performing vulnerability analysis, using automated assessment tools, and identifying risks and mitigations

Experience with the development and sustainment of real-time embedded systems (avionics systems or similar)

Experience with Real-Time Embedded Operating Systems (e.g. GreenHills INEGRITY, LynxOS, VxWorks, Yocto)

Background/knowledge working with information systems/environments that utilize the Open Mission Systems (OMS) standard and Universal Command and Control Standards Initiative (UCI) message set

postings.description:
The Opportunity

AIR6500 will provide a Joint Air Battle Management System capability for the Royal Australian Air Force. The system will provide multi-domain integration of air, electromagnetic, and missile defence battle management including deployable & fixed operations centres, communications, and both active & passive sensors.

Key Responsibilities

- Assist in defining and decomposing system security requirements across Mission and Support Systems.
- Identify security design attributes and articulate how they influence overall system design.
- Plan and oversee cyber security test and evaluation activities, including test plans and test events.
- Conduct system and security reviews and provide recommendations to mitigate identified security risks.
- Prepare core security documentation in support of System Authorisation activities.
- Contribute to security design activities led by the Lead Cyber Architect.
- Provide cyber security subject matter expertise and guidance to stakeholders across security architecture, secure engineering and cyber security supply chain activities.
- Review security architectures and technical solution designs, troubleshoot technical issues and provide cyber security expertise to engineering teams.
- Support cyber security planning, estimating, status monitoring, measurement and reporting activities.
- Provide technical guidance, mentoring, direction and training to build cyber security knowledge and capability.
- Apply relevant cyber security standards, directives, guidance and policies within architectural frameworks.

What you'll bring

- Broad systems engineering lifecycle experience, with the ability to apply this expertise to cyber security architecture, design and development initiatives.

postings.description:
Standard Job Description

Cyber Intel Associate Analyst - Insider Threat / CIRT / Rockville MD

Lockheed Martin's Computer Incident Response Team (CIRT) Insider Threat Team is hiring a Cyber Intel Associate Analyst. This role will report to the Insider Threat Team Associate Manager within Corporate Information Security (CIS).

What You Will Be Doing:

This role will build on foundational knowledge rooted in Cyber Security, focusing on Insider Threat detection methodologies against various operating system, network, and security infrastructure logs to identify potential insider threats within the organization. You will leverage native analytics tools in conjunction with internal and commercial AI/ML models to uncover, surface, and mitigate insider‑threat activity. The role is hands‑on, collaborative, and will provide exposure to the full CIRT lifecycle—from data collection through detection design, automation, and reporting. You will also work with various teams within CIRT, CIS, and across the Enterprise to advance the LM-CIRT missions. Your key responsibilities will include the following:

- Support Complex Problem Investigation. You will be collaborating with senior analysts to explore insider threat scenarios that lack existing detection coverage, executing hypothesis driven searches, aggregating relevant log data, and documenting preliminary findings. Under senior guidance, you will be prototyping a simple detection rule or automation script, testing it on sandbox data, and updating team documentation with the validated solution. This iterative process builds foundational analytical skills while contributing to the evolution of LM CIRT’s detection capabilities.
- Detection Development. You will create Splunk alerts, reports, and simple correlation searches, and be exposed to building YARA rules.
- Log & Data Analysis. You will parse operating system, network, endpoint, and security infrastructure logs (Windows, Linux, cloud) to identify patterns indicative of insider threat behavior.
- Automation & Workflow Enablement. You will identify routine analytic steps that can be automated and create scripts or automation playbooks to reduce manual effort.
- AI assisted Detection Development. You will assist senior analysts in building and refining detection content that incorporates leveraging AI models, Splunk, and automation capabilities.
- Threat Hunting Support. You will participate in structured threat hunting cycles, executing hypothesis driven queries and documenting findings for senior review.
- Reporting & Knowledge Sharing. You will produce concise detection tuning notes, dashboards, and fused intelligence briefings for internal stakeholders (CIRT, Counterintelligence, leadership).
- Agile Collaboration. You will work within the team’s Agile development process (Scrum/Kanban) using JIRA, Git Lab, and Confluence to track work, version control detection code, and maintain documentation.
- Continuous Learning. You will be able to stay current on emerging insider threat tactics, AI/ML advances, and relevant regulatory requirements (e.g., NIST 800 53, DFARS).

This is a highly hands-on technical role that will require you to be comfortable working in a dynamic and fast-paced operational environment, which occasionally can require the flexibility to work off hours.

Further Information About This Opportunity:

This is a hybrid role based out of Rockville MD. US Citizenship is required with eligibility for Secret clearance.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber‑Security, Data Science, or a related technical field
- Basic knowledge of Splunk (search language, dashboard creation)
- Familiarity with at least one scripting language (Python, PowerShell, Bash)
- Experience working in a Unix/Linux command‑line environment
- Demonstrated ability to interpret raw log data, draw logical conclusions, and document findings
- Strong written and verbal communication and ability to present technical material to both technical and non‑technical audiences
- Proven ability to work collaboratively within a team and follow defined processes
- Willingness to work flexible hours or on‑call rotations as required by mission needs
- US Citizenship with eligibility for Secret Clearance or higher

Desired Skills

- Familiarity with basic forensic concepts (memory/image capture, timeline creation) or participation in a cyber‑incident response exercise.
- Understanding of insider‑threat lifecycle, misuse cases, and behavioral analytics.
- Hands‑on experience with Splunk Machine Learning Toolkit, Jupyter notebooks, or other low‑code AI platforms; basic understanding of supervised vs. unsupervised learning.
- Experience using JIRA, Git Lab, or similar version‑control and ticketing systems.
- Splunk Core Certified User, CompTIA Security+, EC‑Council CEH, or a foundational AI/ML certification (e.g., Coursera “AI for Everyone”).
- Prior exposure to IT operations, system administration, network security, or intelligence analysis.

Standard Job Description

What We’re Doing

At Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems, we are shaping the future of defense and security through innovation, integrity, and visionary thinking. Our teams apply the highest standards of business ethics and technical expertise to design solutions that safeguard our nation and allies. Every day, we push boundaries to ensure mission success—and we invite you to be part of this critical work.

The Work

We are seeking a highly motivated Cyber Software Engineer to support the design, implementation, hardening, and sustainment of secure mission systems across both CONUS and OCONUS environments.

This role requires strong technical expertise in systems engineering, cybersecurity, infrastructure security, automation, and DevSecOps practices. The ideal candidate will support secure architecture development, system accreditation activities, continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, and automation of security controls within CI/CD pipelines.

The Cyber Systems Engineer will work closely with software engineers, infrastructure teams, customer representatives, security architects, program leadership, and operational users to ensure mission systems remain secure, resilient, and compliant.

Please note:

This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD government clearance at the Secret level.

This position is based out of King of Prussia, PA or Colorado Springs, CO and is hybrid but required to work onsite 3 days a week.

This position requires the ability to travel up to 50%.

Who We Are

We are Lockheed Martin, a global security and aerospace leader. Our Rotary and Mission Systems (RMS) business area delivers solutions that connect people, protect freedom, and advance the state of technology in areas such as naval systems, radar, cyber, and missile defense.

Who You Are

You are a mission-driven engineer with a strong background in cybersecurity and Software engineering. You thrive in collaborative environments and are passionate about applying your skills to safeguard systems against evolving threats. Your ability to assess risks, develop secure designs, and validate solutions makes you a trusted partner in ensuring mission success.

Why Join Us

At Lockheed Martin, your skills, training, and education are valued—and your future is limitless. You’ll join a team that empowers innovation, supports professional growth, and makes a tangible impact on global security. From day one, you’ll be part of something bigger: protecting what matters most.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in a related field with 5+ years of relevant experience.

• Experience with Linux and Windows operating systems.

• Experience with AI/ML/DL for cyber analysis and auditing.

• Experience with vulnerability scanning and/or patching

At Lockheed Martin's Rotary and Mission System's Cyber Resiliency organization, we are dedicated to engineering and deploying cutting-edge cyber defense solutions across our corporation. • Hardening operating systems, applications, and network devices
• Conducting vulnerability scans
• Continuous monitoring of the security posture of the system
• Assisting with Government Certification Test and Evaluation (CT&E) and Vulnerability Testing
• Implementing security updates and patches

What We’re Doing

At Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems, we are shaping the future of defense and security through innovation, integrity, and visionary thinking. Our teams apply the highest standards of business ethics and technical expertise to design solutions that safeguard our nation and allies. Every day, we push boundaries to ensure mission success—and we invite you to be part of this critical work.

The Work

We are seeking a highly motivated Cyber Security Systems Engineer to support the design, implementation, hardening, and sustainment of secure mission systems across both CONUS and OCONUS environments.

This role requires strong technical expertise in systems engineering, cybersecurity, infrastructure security, automation, and DevSecOps practices. The ideal candidate will support secure architecture development, system accreditation activities, continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, and automation of security controls within CI/CD pipelines.

The Cyber Systems Engineer will work closely with software engineers, infrastructure teams, customer representatives, security architects, program leadership, and operational users to ensure mission systems remain secure, resilient, and compliant.

We are Lockheed Martin, a global security and aerospace leader. Our Rotary and Mission Systems (RMS) business area delivers solutions that connect people, protect freedom, and advance the state of technology in areas such as naval systems, radar, cyber, and missile defense.

You are a mission-driven engineer with a strong background in cybersecurity and systems engineering. Standard Job Description

You will be a Cyber Systems Security Engineer Sr in the Program Protection Organization. Our organization oversees all aspects of Anti-Tamper and embedded Cybersecurity across Missiles and Fire Control. We are chartered with providing the skills and innovative technologies to develop, design, produce and sustain secure products across our Lines of Business.

What You Will Be Doing
As the Cyber Systems Security Engineer you will be responsible for providing embedded System Security Engineering design and implementation in all aspects of System Security Engineering (SSE) process in development of Department of Defense (DoD) Weapon Systems. Your responsibilities will include:
• Assessing and mitigating System Security threats/risks throughout the embedded Weapon System development life cycle.
• Validating System Security Engineering requirements decomposition, allocation and analysis for embedded Weapon Systems.
• Implementing System Security Engineering solutions hardware and software.
• Verifying implementation of system security requirements.
• Designing, implementing, deploying, and maintaining state of the art System Security architectures and countermeasures to protect and enable innovative new Lockheed Martin Missiles and Fire Control products.
• Analyzing weaknesses, vulnerabilities and threats against System Security posture on product designs.
• Prototyping and testing System Security countermeasures that defend against cyber-attacks against Lockheed Martin Missiles and Fire Control Weapon System products.

*For a level 3, we typically look for a Bachelors degree from an accredited college in a related discipline, or equivalent experience/combined education, with 5 years of professional experience; or 3 years of professional experience with a related Masters degree, or equivalent experience/combined education.

Do you want to be part of a company culture that empowers employees to think big, lead with a growth mindset, and make the impossible a reality? We provide the resources and give you the flexibility to enable inspiration and focus -if you have the passion and courage to dream big, work hard, and have fun doing what you love then we want to build a better tomorrow with you.

You will be a Cyber Security Engineer in the Program Protection Organization. Our organization oversees all aspects of Anti-Tamper and embedded Cybersecurity across Missiles and Fire Control. We are chartered with providing the skills and innovative technologies to develop, design, produce and sustain secure products across our Lines of Business.

• Assessing and mitigating System Security threats/risks throughout the embedded Weapon System development life cycle

• Validating System Security Engineering requirements decomposition, allocation and analysis for embedded Weapon Systems

• Implementing System Security Engineering solutions hardware and software

• Designing, implementing, deploying, and maintaining state of the art System Security architectures and countermeasures to protect and enable innovative new Lockheed Martin Missiles and Fire Control products

• Prototyping and testing System Security countermeasures that defend against cyber-attacks against Lockheed Martin Missiles and Fire Control Weapon System products

• Integrate yourself amongst Hardware, Firmware, Software, and Systems Engineers to define and
integrate System Security Engineering into a wide range of high integrity, security and safety-critical Systems

Standard Job Description

Lockheed Martin’s Red Team is seeking an experienced Cyber Test Exploitation professional. If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and applying ethical hacking techniques to protect cutting‑edge military technology, this role offers the chance to put your skills to work for the corporation, our customers, and the warfighter.

What You Will Be Doing:

In this role, you will lead and execute advanced exploitation and penetration‑testing initiatives, assess potential attack vectors, and develop mitigations that enhance Lockheed Martin’s overall security posture. Key responsibilities will include the following:

- Leading and conducting exploitation and penetration testing, research, and development across Lockheed Martin enterprises, products, programs, and technologies
- Identifying potential exploitation or malicious attack vectors and implementing mitigations to strengthen our security posture
- Applying a broad range of standard and custom testing tactics, techniques, and procedures to uncover security weaknesses, assess attack surfaces, and recommend remediation
- Collaborating with senior technical partners on critical business and information‑security matters, delivering actionable results
- Coordinating penetration‑testing and red‑teaming activities across multiple organizations to support enterprise‑wide initiatives
- Influencing security practices for Lockheed Martin environments, contracts, and business units

Who You Are:

- A technically proficient cyber professional with a solid background in penetration testing and the ability to contribute immediately to engagements.
- Strong analytical and critical‑thinking skills with a proven track record of problem solving and follow‑through.
- Capable of multitasking effectively in a fast‑paced environment.
- Self‑starter and team player who quickly masters new concepts under senior guidance.
- Creative, collaborative, and mission‑focused, with a positive attitude toward achieving strategic objectives.

Further Information About This Opportunity:

This is a hybrid role with part-time telecommuting; proximity to one of the listed Lockheed Martin facilities (Fort Worth TX, Orlando FL, or Bethesda MD) is preferred, though other major sites may be considered. US citizenship is required, with eligibility for Secret clearance or higher

Conducts exploitation testing to improve integrity and security of enterprise and weapon system environments. Performs penetration testing and related activities across a wide variety of platforms and technologies using advanced techniques and methodologies, such as embedded hardware, electronic warfare, radio frequency, etc. Utilizes domain knowledge to develop systems and exploitation methods for use in cyber and adjacent-field missions. - Understanding of AI safety concepts (guardrails, alignment, output filtering) and how they can be bypassed or reinforced in offensive scenarios
- US citizenship is required to start, with eligibility for Secret Clearance or higher

- Certifications (OSCP, OSCE, OSEP, OSED, CEH, CEPT, GIAC {Web, wireless, forensics, mobile, exploit researcher})
- Experience with cloud technologies such as AWS and Azure

- Familiarity with Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) activity; Offensive hacker mindset

postings.title: Cybersecurity Test & Evaluation (T&E) Lead
postings.description:
Standard Job Description

What We're Doing

Our team, the Command and Control, Battle Management and Communications (C2BMC) team at Lockheed Martin, is dedicated to engineering, developing, and integrating new capabilities for the Missile Defense System that protects the United States and its allies. While we are part of a large organization, we operate within smaller, agile teams in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Our responsibilities include Sensor/Weapon Integration, Algorithm Development, User Interface Development, Automated Testing, Cyber Security, and enhancing critical missile defense technologies.

The Work

The Cybersecurity T&E lead will report to the C2BMC Program leadership and is responsible for coordinating no less than 20 high-visibility MDA Cyber Events for the C2BMC element of the Ballistic Missile Defense System (BMDS).

This individual will responsible for lead the Cybersecurity Test and Evaluation (T&E) planning, execution and reporting of multiple T&E projects and MDA Cyber Events, documenting actionable T&E metrics, and communicating with various intra/inter MDA-related organizations. They will be expected to frequently brief results and POAMs to MDA Executive leadership on behalf of C2BMC. Ensure that team projects are completed on schedule following established program procedures, schedules, and work plans. Plan for and coordinate across National Team to ensure appropriate resources are represented at each C2BMC T&E Event. Conduct post event analysis and ensure results from MDA Cyber events and the solutions to those results are incorporated into the Agile Development Lifecycle.

The position's daily tasks include but not limited to: researching, developing, and recommending appropriate Cybersecurity countermeasures for networks, systems, and/or applications based upon test and evaluation information. Also, supporting various Cybersecurity T&E reviews performed by multiple external organizations and identifies gaps in security architecture, resulting in recommendations for inclusion in a risk mitigation strategy. The individual will also maintain Cyber T&E Plans and POAMs to ensure compliance with DoD policies and directives, Provide USCYBERCOM guidance, risk mitigation, and minimum-security policies and requirements. Collaborate with other T&E organizations to develop rules of engagement (RoE), tailored test plans, and synchronizes efforts across all T&E efforts Candidate must be able to be self-initiated and capable of leading large groups of people and data to drive solutions to and increase cyber posture of C2BMC Depending on mission and test event requirements travel to CONUS and/or OCONUS locations will be required.

Position requires on-call, evening, and weekend support during system anomalies and/or Cybersecurity tests. This position is primarily located at the MDIOC (Schriever Space Force Base) with the C2BMC ISSM and will also involve collaboration with stake holders at Hwy 83.

Who We Are

As leaders of the C2BMC team, Lockheed Martin partners with industry leaders to develop and field the backbone of America’s missile defense. Our national team supports the design, development, testing, integration, and fielding of hardware and software elements essential for the effective operation of the Missile Defense System (MDS). You will have opportunities to interface directly with key customers, including the Missile Defense Agency (MDA).

At C2BMC, you will work alongside a talented team of technical professionals, including software and systems engineers, architects, and project engineering teams, at our Federal Drive location in the northern part of Colorado Springs. Enjoy the beautiful mountain backdrop and 300 days of sunshine, with opportunities for winter sports even in May.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of related experience and may have a post-secondary degree or training in a related discipline.

• Active Secret Security Clearance, at start.

• Possess an approved DoD 8570 baseline certification for IAT Level II (CISSP, CAP, etc.), at start.

The Candidate must have the ability to:

• Advise C2BMC leadership and senior MDA leadership to support the planning and execution of MDA Cyber events.

• Consult on and brief complex technical cyber information, concepts, or ideas in a confident and well-organized manner.

• Evaluate effectiveness of Cybersecurity architecture and engineering for suitability, survivability, and interoperability of systems to provide key feedback to improve the overall Cybersecurity posture of C2BMC systems.

The Candidate must possess:

• Advanced experience in research and development in providing solutions in emerging Cybersecurity threats to analyze security findings/weaknesses and develop an executable Plan of Action and Milestones (POAMs) for remediation of findings and revalidation of applied fixes.

• Extensive experience reviewing test plans, coordinating with multiple key stake holders, engineering documentation, and evaluating scenarios as they relate to Cybersecurity and Cyber events.

• Subject Matter Expert (SME) understanding and practical application of DoD policies and directives, USCYBERCOM guidance, NIST standards, and RMF controls for a Mission System.

Desired Skills

• Experience supporting DoD weapon systems, aviation platforms, or classified mission systems.
• Experience with Containerization technologies to include Kubernetes and Openshift
• Experience with Virtualization platforms/hypervisors
• Experience implementing container security and Kubernetes hardening.
• Familiarity with SIEM Tools deployment and administration specifically ArcSight
• Experience with Zero Trust architecture and cyber resiliency engineering.
• Experience supporting environmental handling:
• Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI)
• Air-gapped or disconnected systems

WHAT WE’RE DOING
At Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems, we're on a mission to drive innovation and uphold the highest standards of business ethics. We believe that by pushing the boundaries of visionary thinking, we can achieve exceptional results. As a Lockheed Martin employee, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while working in an environment that values integrity and excellence.

THE WORK
The Cyber Systems Security Engineering team in Moorestown, NJ is seeking a Cybersecurity Validation Engineer to design, develop, and execute security validation activities to identify vulnerabilities, verify security controls. and ensure products and systems meet cybersecurity and anti-tamper requirements. You will work closely with cross functional engineers, program managers, and customers to ensure security requirements are met and to evaluate emerging threat vectors.
In this role you will:
• Develop and execute cybersecurity validation and verification plans, test cases, and procedures.
• Verify system security design requirements and capabilities through rigorous analysis and testing.
• Conduct security testing, vulnerability assessment, penetration-testing and attack-surface analysis.

• Design negative, boundary, fault-injection and abuse-case testing scenarios to identify potential security weaknesses.
• Analyze test results, document findings, and track vulnerabilities through resolution.
• Validate security mechanisms such as authentication, authorization, encryption, secure boot, access controls, key management and intrusion detection.

• Maintain all security validation documentation, test reports, evidence and traceability artifacts.

postings.description:
Standard Job Description

Lockheed Martin is seeking a seasoned Data Architect, Team Lead to act as a servant leader for a high performing data management team. In this role you will define, design, and govern enterprise wide data solutions, ensure compliance with DoD/SOFSA policies, and serve as the central point of contact for all data related support requests. Bachelor’s degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field (Master’s preferred).

Familiarity with secure coding techniques.

Use of outlier identification and removal techniques.

Implementing data labeling governance to improve discoverability and understandability.

Understanding and selecting appropriate cloud deployment models (private, public, hybrid) and the differences between on premises and off premises environments.

Experience in utilizing the Agile Methodology approach to systems development.

Strong communication and leadership skills

Standard Job Description

WHAT WE'RE DOING
Lockheed Martin, Rotary Mission Systems Cyber & Intelligence invites you to step up to one of today’s most daunting challenges: the use of advanced electronics to undermine our way of life. As a cyber security professional at Lockheed Martin, you’ll protect the networks that our citizens and the world depend upon each minute: Financial assets. Healthcare information. Critical infrastructure. Hazardous materials. The uninterrupted flow of energy that keeps modern life moving. Here, you’ll work with cybersecurity experts on the forefront of threat protection and proactive prevention. In this fast-paced, real-world environment, you’ll draw on all your education and experience as well as the resources of Lockheed Martin to keep the threats at bay.

THE WORK
As a Database Engineer – Junior-Level you will be responsible for:
• Provides technical expertise for database design, development, implementation, information storage and retrieval, data flow and analysis
• Develops relational and/or Object-Oriented databases, database parser software, and database loading software
• Projects long-range requirements for database administration and design
• Responsible for developing a database structure that fits into the overall architecture of the system under development and has to make trades among data volumes, number of users, logical and physical distribution, response times, retention rules, security and domain controls.
• The DBE works primarily at the front end of the lifecycle-requirements through system acceptance testing and Initial Operational Capability (IOC)
• Develops requirements from a project’s inception to its conclusion for a particular business and Information Technology (IT) subject matter area (i.e., simple to complex systems)
• Assist with recommendations for, and analysis and evaluation of systems improvements, optimization, development, and/or maintenance efforts
• Translates a set of requirements and data into a usable document by creating or recreating ad hoc queries, scripts, and macros; updates existing queries, creates new ones to manipulate data into a master file; and builds complex systems using queries, tables, Open Database Connectivity and database storage and retrieval using Cloud methodologies

The program is on fire for cyber. In support of our customer, members of the team are responsible for providing full lifecycle support including analysis, design, development, integration, testing, procurement, deployment, security, training and sustainment for collection and antenna systems.

Your Health, Your Wealth, Your Life

Space is a critical domain, connecting our technologies, our security and our humanity. While others view space as a destination, we see it as a realm of possibilities, where we can do more — we can innovate, invest, inspire and integrate our capabilities to transform the future.

Join us in shaping a new era in space and find a career that's built for you.

The successful candidate should be excited about opportunities incorporating new technologies into the software development process. They should also be confident in their ability to maintain a development infrastructure and perform to customer specifications. This role will also be able to perform certain system administration functions to support development efforts.
Strong documentation skills are a plus in this role.

• Strong Technical Expertise: Proficient in coding, scripting, and automation tools. Knowledgeable in cloud technologies, containers, and orchestration tools like Kubernetes.

• Security Knowledge: Deep understanding of security principles, practices, and tools. Familiar with threat modeling, risk assessment techniques, and security testing tools.

• Collaboration and Communication: Ability to work closely with development, operations, and security teams. Excellent communication skills to articulate security concerns and solutions effectively.

• Continuous Learning: Stays updated with the latest security threats, technologies, and DevSecOps trends. Demonstrates a commitment to ongoing professional development.

• Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical skills to identify and solve security and operational challenges in a timely and effective manner.

• Automation Mindset: Leverages automation to integrate security into CI/CD pipelines efficiently. Familiar with tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, and automated security testing tools.

• Risk Management: Ability to assess, prioritize, and manage security risks in alignment with business objectives.

• Compliance and Governance: Understanding of legal and regulatory requirements related to information security. Ensures that DevSecOps practices comply with these standards.

Performs tech planning, design, devel, integ, v&v for total syst life cycle. Analyses performed at all levels of syst product incl. concept, design, fabrication, test, instl, operation, maintenance & disposal, incorp design methods & stds for Cyber Security, SW & HW infrastructure. Designs, devels, docs, tests & debugs SW that contains logical & math solutions to business/mission problems/questions in computer language. Ensures the logical & syst conversion of customer/product reqs into total syst solutions that ack tech, sched, cost constraints & align to SW & HW deployment pipelines & factories. Performs func & timeline analysis, detail trade & reqs allocation & interface defs studies to translate customer reqs into HW & SW feature defs & acceptance criteria. Applies stds, processes, procedures & tools throughout the devel life cycle. Applies HW & SW knowledge, cyber security stds in business/mission apps, & feedback from users to develop SW. Corrects program errors, prepares operating instructions, compiles doc of program devel & analyzes syst capabilities to resolve program problems, output/input data acq, programming tech & controls. Ensures SW stds are met. Validates incorp of features & use cases into implemented designs

Basic Qualifications

The successful candidate must have demonstrated experience with the following automation technologies:
• Git
• Infrastructure as Code (Ansible, Terraform, Packer)
• Kubernetes
• Helm
• AWS or Openstack
• Security+

Desired Skills

The successful candidate may have additional demonstrated experience with the following automation technologies:
• ArgoCD

The successful candidate should be excited about opportunities incorporating new technologies into the software development process. Strong documentation skills are a plus in this role.

postings.description:
Job Description

Space is a critical domain, connecting our technologies, our security and our humanity. While others view space as a destination, we see it as a realm of possibilities, where we can do more — we can innovate, invest, inspire and integrate our capabilities to transform the future.

At Lockheed Martin Space, we aim to harness the full potential of space to cultivate innovation, reduce costs, and push the boundaries of what technology can achieve. We’re creating future-ready solutions, focusing on resiliency and urgency through our 21st Century Security vision. We’re erasing boundaries and forming partnerships across industries and around the world. We’re advancing spacecraft and the workforce to fuel the next generation. And we’re reimagining how space can connect us, ensuring security and prosperity.

Join us in shaping a new era in space and find a career that's built for you.

Are you passionate about integrating cutting-edge technologies while ensuring robust security measures? We’re seeking talented individuals at all levels to join our dynamic team as DevSecOps Engineers, with a particular emphasis on Infrastructure Engineering expertise.

About The Role

At Lockheed Martin, we’ll provide you with meaningful work and education opportunities that will allow you to develop your skills and enhance your career with us, but equally important, you can also enjoy a strong work-life balance. To ensure this, we offer a flexible work schedule and a comprehensive benefits package to enable you to live a healthy, fulfilling life in and outside of work.

You’ll play a pivotal role in integrating, administering and securing a range of systems and applications, with a strong focus on designing, building, and maintaining scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure. As an Infrastructure Engineer within our DevSecOps team, you’ll be at the forefront of driving innovation and safeguarding digital infrastructures by ensuring robust, high-performance systems that support our mission-critical solutions.

You’ll need to have an understanding Linux systems and DevSecOps principles and experience of working within a multi-disciplined team. Knowledge and understanding of core software tools, methods, and frameworks to reliably integrate and deploy, integrate, and test features into environments to ensure optimum outcomes for our customers. Additionally, we’re looking for candidates with hands-on experience in infrastructure engineering, including expertise in areas such as cloud architecture, containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible), and system performance optimization to support seamless integration and testing processes.

Basic Qualifications

As a Dev Sec Engineer in Infrastructure team you will:

• Collaborate with Infrastructure Team Leadership to design and construct the Integrated Development Environments required to support software development, testing, and deployment.

• Automate deployment of workspaces and services using tools like Ansible, Terraform

• Manage security information and event management monitoring and logging tools to ensure system performance and security.

• Remediate vulnerabilities within the information systems and maintain security compliance.

• Provide on-site and remote support to analyze and resolve technical issues for development and test teams working within the Integrated Development Environments.

As part of an Agile Development Team, you will actively participate in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to ensure continuous delivery of high-quality solutions. Your contributions will help maintain the secure and uninterrupted communication capabilities of critical military systems.

Desired Skills

- Proficient in the field of DevSecOps. The ability to work within an agile environment and delivering using Scrum and Sprints utilising tools such as Jira and Confluence to help planning and collaboration.
- Experience of Linux RHEL base systems
- Understanding of Automation technologies Terraform and Ansible for complex builds.
- Experience of Gitlab CI/CD pipeline builds, CI components, modules.
- Understanding of Git/Bitbucket/GitLab integration, coding and branching strategies
- Experience of Python, Bash scripting
- Knowledge of Cloud and AWS concepts and technologies
- Experience with container orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes
- This position requires U.S. citizenship, the candidate require the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret Clearance

Interview Questions

DevSecOps: Describe your previous working experience with DevSecOps. What were your role and duties?

DevSecOps: How did you evaluate the performance and efficiency of a DevSecOps tool?

DevSecOps: What challenges have you met when deploying containerization and microservices transformation in your organization? And how did you solve them?

Communicate with Positive Impact: Tell me about a sensitive or volatile situation that required very careful communication.

Standard Job Description

Lockheed Martin is a global leader in aerospace, defense, and technology solutions, dedicated to pushing the boundaries of innovation and shaping the future of the industry. With a rich legacy of excellence and a commitment to delivering advanced capabilities to our customers, we are proud to be at the forefront of cutting-edge technology and engineering.

THE WORK

Position Assignment: Flight Simulator Systems Admin for the F 35 supporting Japanese Air Self Defense Force (JASDF) in Nyutabaru, Japan.

The successful candidate will work closely with other members of the Lockheed Martin training team and Japanese Air Self Defense Force (JASDF) to fulfill F 35 training objectives in Nyutabaru, Japan.

This position will support the sustainment, maintenance, and operation of F 35 training devices. Provide technical and operational services to support electronic and mechanical devices used for training personnel under simulated flying conditions. Troubleshoots complex technical IT problems and issues, determines technical solution. Maintain simulator documentation to include drawings, instructions, parts and software listings, by keeping them current, edited, and revised for future releases. Maintains smooth operation of multi user computer systems, sets up administrator and user accounts, maintains current system documentation, tunes system performance, installs system wide software, and allocates mass storage space. Performs workstation Network Administration on all networks and ensures compliance to include upgrading, patching, and conducting weekly AV installs. Monitors policies and standards for all locations related to the use of computing resources and coordinates installation and provides backup recovery.

• Implement and support Lockheed Martin initiatives, programs and policies as directed.
• Comply with site security and access control procedures in accordance with F 35 program and customer procedures.
• Sanitize all classified media (circuit cards, disk storage devices, etc.) to the LRU in accordance with established F 35 and customer procedures.

Foreign Assignment: This position will offer a long term deployment to a foreign country supporting Japanese Air Self Defense Force (JASDF) in Nyutabaru, Japan.

Accompanied Status Availability: Accompanied status means new hires may have qualifying dependents accompany them on their long term overseas assignment.

Foreign Location Premium(s): Available.

Candidates be advised: This position operates in direct support of a deployable F 35 fighter squadron. The selected applicant selected may be required to work at deployed locations, work rotating shifts, and work in excess of 40 hours per week.

F-35 Fast Facts

You are a dynamic and results-oriented professional with a passion for driving operational excellence and optimizing production processes. postings.description:
Standard Job Description

Plans, conducts, and coordinates software development activities. Designs, develops, documents, tests, and debugs software that contains logical and mathematical solutions to business/mission problems or questions in computer language for solutions by means of data processing equipment. Applies the appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools throughout the development life cycle. Applies knowledge of computer hardware and software, subject matter to be programmed in business/mission applications, information processing techniques used, and information gathered from system users to develop software. Corrects program errors, prepares operating instructions, compiles documentation of program development, and analyzes system capabilities to resolve questions of program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques, and controls. Ensures software standards are met.

Lockheed Martin Space is seeking a full‑time Senior Testbed Architect with a strong software‑test background to lead the design, development, and validation of advanced hardware‑in‑the‑loop (HIL) and software‑in‑the‑loop (SIL) test environments for the CPS program. The Senior Testbed Architect will define and drive the end‑to‑end test strategy, integrating real‑time simulation, embedded software, and high‑fidelity hardware rigs to verify guidance, navigation, and control (GNC) subsystems and autonomous capabilities. Leveraging deep expertise in real‑time, fault‑tolerant software testing, CI/CD automation, and system‑level integration, this role ensures rigorous, repeatable, and secure test processes that meet stringent performance, safety, and schedule requirements within a fast‑paced, defense‑focused development environment.

-  15 + years of progressive systems engineering experience, extensive hands‑on experience with hardware‑in‑the‑loop (HWIL) verification and simulation platforms for mission‑critical defense programs.

- Definition of system architectures, integration strategies, technical roadmaps, and executable program schedules.

- Real‑time computing environments (RTOS, Linux‑RT, etc).
