postings.title: Information Assurance Engineer Sr Stf - E5
postings.description:
About the Role

Be part of a team delivering the next generation of secure military communications satellites for the UK Ministry of Defence. This work provides resilient, high‑performance connectivity for the UK, its allies and Defence personnel worldwide, playing a critical role in protecting national security as space becomes more contested and demand for secure data continues to grow.

Joining Lockheed Martin also means helping to shape significant investment in the North East space sector, with more than £100 million proposed to support high‑skill jobs, advanced manufacturing and long‑term economic growth. Opportunities include potential satellite manufacturing in County Durham and collaboration with NESST – the North East Space Skills and Technology Centre at Northumbria University – helping to build a strong pipeline of talent, learning and innovation.

The Role:

Please note this role will be based in Newcastle.

This is your chance to work on mission‑critical technology, develop cutting‑edge skills and build a meaningful career, while delivering lasting impact for the region and the nation.

Provides security engineering designs and implementation in all aspects of Information Assurance and Information Security (InfoSec) Engineering.

Assesses and mitigates system security threats/risks throughout the program life cycle; validates system security requirements definition and analysis; establishes system security designs; implements security designs in hardware, software, data, and procedures; verifies security requirements; performs system certification and accreditation planning and testing and liaison activities, and supports secure systems operations and maintenance.

Develops highly innovative solutions to problems of unusual complexity. Works under consultative direction towards long-range goals and objectives, often self-initiating assignments. Work is checked through consultation and agreement with others, rather than by a superior.

Designs, researches and develops ideas to generate final products. May take on a project/program leadership role. Decisions impact financial, employee, or public relations posture.

Serves as a consultant on highly significant matters and long-range objectives.

Represents the organisation as a spokesperson on advanced projects.

Applies advanced concepts to develop new applications based on professional theories. Recognized expert in the field within the corporation.

Required Skills, Qualifications and Experience

- The successful candidate will be an expert in cyber security/information security and knowledgeable of all aspects of cyber security in relation to space and ground based communication systems, computer systems and other processing systems.
- Knowledge of NIST standards or equivalents and their implementation in a company is highly desirable.
- Significant related experience and may have a post-secondary degree or training in a related discipline.

postings.title: Information Security Engineer - Classified Systems
postings.description:
About the role

Reporting to the EMEA Information Security Officer, the Information Security Engineer will be responsible for the security engineering, accreditation, and lifecycle assurance of classified and sensitive IT systems. The role will support the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of secure IT environments, ensuring compliance with UK Government, MoD, and Lockheed Martin security requirements.

The successful candidate will work closely with programme teams, architects, infrastructure engineers, accrediting authorities, and information assurance stakeholders to ensure security is embedded throughout the system lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities:

- Lead the implementation of Secure by Design principles across classified IT systems and projects.
- Provide security engineering expertise throughout the system development and operational lifecycle, ensuring security requirements are identified and implemented from concept through disposal.
- Conduct security architecture reviews, threat assessments, and technical risk analysis for classified environments.
- Support the development and maintenance of system security documentation, security architectures, and security operating procedures.
- Lead and coordinate system accreditation activities for classified and sensitive systems.
- Develop and maintain accreditation artefacts including Risk Management and Accreditation Documentation Sets (RMADS), Security Cases, Security Management Plans, and supporting evidence.
- Work with Accreditors, Security Controllers, and customer security representatives to obtain and maintain Authority to Operate (ATO) approvals.
- Ensure continued compliance with applicable regulatory, contractual, and customer security requirements throughout system operation.
- Identify, assess, and mitigate cybersecurity risks within classified IT environments.
- Conduct security assessments, vulnerability reviews, and compliance audits against corporate and government security standards.
- Support risk treatment planning and remediation activities.
- Ensure alignment with NCSC, MoD, JSP, NIST, and Lockheed Martin security policies and standards where applicable.
- Support incident response investigations affecting classified systems.
- Assist with vulnerability management, patch management, and security monitoring activities.
- Participate in security reviews and technical investigations to identify root causes and corrective actions.
- Provide technical guidance to system administrators and engineering teams on security controls and best practices.
- Collaborate with programme managers, solution architects, IT teams, information assurance practitioners, and customer representatives.
- Provide security guidance to project teams during system design, implementation, and operational support phases.
- Support customer and regulatory audits and inspections.

Required skills, qualifications and experience

- Strong understanding of Microsoft Windows Server, Linux operating systems, virtualisation technologies, and enterprise networking.
- Experience securing classified, air-gapped, or highly regulated IT environments.
- Knowledge of cloud security principles including AWS, IaaS, and PaaS technologies where applicable.
- Familiarity with security technologies including endpoint protection, SIEM, vulnerability management, encryption, and identity management solutions
- Demonstrable experience applying Secure by Design principles in complex IT systems and programmes.
- Experience conducting security architecture reviews, threat modelling, and risk assessments.
- Strong understanding of system hardening, security controls implementation, and security testing methodologies.
- Experience supporting system engineering and security requirements management within regulated environments.

Accreditation & ATO Experience

- Proven experience developing accreditation evidence and security assurance documentation.
- Experience obtaining and maintaining Authority to Operate (ATO) approvals for classified or regulated systems.
- Knowledge of UK Government and MoD accreditation processes and assurance frameworks.
- Experience working directly with accrediting authorities, security controllers, or customer assurance organisations.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to communicate technical security concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to work independently while supporting multiple programmes and stakeholders.
- CISSP, CISM, or equivalent Information Assurance certification.
- Degree in Cyber Security, Information Security, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
- Experience within Defence, Aerospace, Government, or National Security sectors.

Additional Requirements

- Knowledge of UK Government Security Policy Framework (SPF), NCSC guidance, JSP 440, and Defence security requirements.
- Understanding of GDPR and UK Data Protection Act requirements where applicable.
- Ability to obtain and maintain UK Security Check (SC) clearance with willingness and eligibility to achieve Developed Vetting (DV) clearance.
- Occasional UK and EMEA travel may be required.

postings.description:
Job Description

The position requires a current Secret clearance and the ability to obtain a Top Secret security clearance.

Lockheed Martin Space (LMS) is seeking a Classified Cybersecurity Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO) supporting the Fleet Ballistic Missile (FBM) program. This position is located in Cape Canaveral, FL. The selected candidate will conduct daily cybersecurity operations, to include auditing, creating information system authorization packages, and implementing cybersecurity requirements for both classified and unclassified information systems.

Key Responsibilities of this role include:

- Carry out technical administration of an Information System in accordance with internal LM and customer security requirements, primarily Risk Management Framework (RMF).
- Upkeep, monitor, analyze, and respond to network and security events.
- Document compliance actions within the approved compliance tracking system or develop a plan of actions and milestones (POA&M) with the Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM) to address non-compliance in the allotted time frame.
- Ensure systems are operated, maintained, and disposed of in accordance with internal security policies and practices outlined in the security plan.
- Operate and maintain ACAS laptops and servers utilizing Tenable Security Center and Nessus Security scanner.
- Audit various isolated and networked systems using vulnerability scanning and STIG analysis tools.
- Ensure compliance to governing documents and security policies and assist in regulatory periodic assessments.
- Implements and tests state-of-the-art secure operating systems, networks, and database solutions.
- Stays current with system vulnerabilities and provides current security training to all system users.
- Conducts risk assessments and provides recommendations for secure implementation and compliance in accordance with government regulations and information assurance/cybersecurity guidelines.
- Creates, maintains and submits information system security documents and reports to regulatory agencies.
- Assesses and mitigates system security threats/risks throughout the program life cycle; validates system security requirements definition and analysis; establishes system security documentation; assists with the implementation of security procedures; verifies information system security requirements; performs information system certification and accreditation planning, testing, assessing and liaison activities.
- Familiar with information system security architectural documentation standards. Able to apply information assurance / cyber security standards, directives, guidance and policies to an architectural/risk based framework.
- Provide architectural / risk based analysis of information assurance / cyber security features and relate existing system to future needs and trends and requirements.

Basic Qualifications

- DoD Secret government security clearance with an investigation within the last 5 years and the ability to obtain and maintain a Top-Secret clearance.
- Knowledge of system hardening via implementation of the Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs).
- Knowledge of security scanning tools such as SCAP, Evaluate-STIG and Tenable.
- Appropriate DoD 8570 IAT II Certification.
- Information System auditing experience.

Desired Skills

- Experience with industry standard Information Assurance tools such as Splunk, Fortify, or SonarQube.
- Proficiency in multiple platforms to include Windows, Linux/Unix, and Networking equipment.
- Proficient writing technical documentation.
- Experience with Navy Fleet Ballistic Missile (FBM) program.
- Knowledge of NIST SP 800-37 Risk Management Framework (RMF), NIST SP 800-53 Security and Privacy Controls requirements, and NIST 800-171 Protecting Controlled Unclassified Information in Nonfederal Systems and Organizations.
- Knowledge of and experience developing, reviewing and maintaining RMF artifacts.
- Knowledge of NIST-171 and supply chain management requirements

We are committed to supporting your work‑life balance and overall well‑being, offering flexible scheduling options. Learn more about Lockheed Martin’s comprehensive benefits package here.

postings.title: Lead ISSO - Classified Cyber Security Stf - E4
postings.description:
Standard Job Description

Ensure compliance to governing documents and security policies and assist in regulatory periodic assessments. Implements and tests state-of-the-art secure operating systems, networks, and database solutions. Stays current with system vulnerabilities and provides current security training to all system users. Conducts risk assessments and provides recommendations for secure implementation and compliance in accordance with government regulations and information assurance/cybersecurity guidelines. Creates, maintains and submits information system security documents and reports to regulatory agencies. Assesses and mitigates system security threats/risks throughout the program life cycle; validates system security requirements definition and analysis; establishes system security documentation; assists with the implementation of security procedures; verifies information system security requirements; performs information system certification and accreditation planning, testing, assessing and liaison activities. Familiar with information system security architectural documentation standards. Able to apply information assurance / cyber security standards, directives, guidance and policies to an architectural/risk based framework. Provide architectural / risk based analysis of information assurance / cyber security features and relate existing system to future needs and trends and requirements. For engineers providing security information assurance, use Info Assurance Engineer (E254, L254). For security professionals providing systems security analysis, use Computer Systems Security Analysis (E121, L121).

Long Description

The position will serve as the Lead ISSO for the Governance & Compliance Team Lead position, responsible for establishing and maintaining the security posture of assigned information systems across the classified environments. Reporting to the Information System Security Manager, the position will serve as the primary cybersecurity liaison with program managers, auditors, configuration management teams, and external assessment bodies.

The role drives the development, upkeep, and validation of all authorization to operate (ATO) artifacts such as: system security plans, hardware and software inventories, network diagrams, and user listings to ensure that security controls are fully implemented, continuously monitored, and documented in compliance tools such as eMASS and Q Compliance. Core duties include coordinating RMF activities, conducting self inspections and readiness assessments, managing continuous monitoring processes, and maintaining up to date compliance dashboards. The Team Lead also oversees configuration management, controls access and privileged accounts, administers interconnection security agreements, and ensures that security awareness and training requirements are met for all personnel. Incident response responsibilities encompass developing and exercising response plans, coordinating real world or simulated events, and documenting all actions and lessons learned.

Additionally, the position develops and maintains contingency and media protection plans, verifies backup and sanitization procedures, and provides regular briefings to leadership on risk, compliance status, and remediation progress. Candidates should have a minimum of five years of experience in continuous monitoring, security control assessment, and compliance management within DoD or comparable regulated environments, with strong knowledge of RMF, NIST SP 800‑53, and associated tooling, as well as proven leadership and communication skills. This position requires flexibility to support mission critical tasks, including off shift work when necessary, to ensure the organization’s information systems remain secure, auditable, and mission ready.

Basic Qualifications

All candidates must possess a Secret Clearance.

All candidates must possess a DoD 8570 IAM Level I certification or higher (e.g., Security + CE, CAP, CASP CE, CISM, CISSP, GSLC, or equivalent).

Demonstrated experience applying and documenting policy and system configurations that satisfy NIST 800-53 Security Control requirements across all Control Families.

Demosntrate experience with eMASS.

Ability to interpret the requirements necessary for the effective implementation of Security Controls. Technologies include but are not limited to Windows, Linux, Virtualization, Network Infrastructure, etc.

Ability to develop and update relevant RMF artifacts such as the System Security Plan (SSP), Plan of Actions and Milestones (POA&M), Security Controls Traceability Matrix (SCTM), as well as the associated security policies and procedures.

Desired Skills

Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence others to gain support.

Demonstratable experience conducting internal and external customer assessments identifying areas for improvement and developing and implementing corrective action plans.

Proven ability to evaluate proposed changes or additions to the information system, including: assessing their security relevance, providing advisory support to the ISSM, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations and standards.

Prior experience as an Information System Security Manager (ISSM) or Information System Security Officer (ISSO), with a proven track record of: Collaborating with a team of ISSOs to satisfy requirements and achieve goals and providing leadership and guidance on information system security matters.

Ability to perform continuous monitoring activities using Industry Standard tools such as Tenable Nessus, Security Center, Splunk, HBSS ePO, etc.

Experience leveraging Defense Information System Agency (DISA) Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) and configuration standards to support system hardening.

postings.description:
Standard Job Description

Lockheed Martin is a cybersecurity pioneer, partner, innovator and builder. Our amazing employees are on a mission to make a difference in the world and every single day we use our unique skills and experiences to create, design and build solutions to some of the worlds’ hardest engineering problems.

Do you want to be part of a culture that inspires employees to think big, perform with excellence and build incredible products? We provide the resources, inspiration and focus – if you have the passion and courage to dream big, then we want to build a better tomorrow with you.

At Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems (RMS), we are driven by innovation and integrity. We believe that by applying the highest standards of business ethics and visionary thinking, everything is within our reach – and yours as a Lockheed Martin employee. Lockheed Martin values your skills, training and education. Come and experience your future!

We are looking for an Information System Security Officer (ISSO) to join the RMS Classified Cyber Security (CCS) team. This exciting opportunity is located in Honolulu, HI and will support multiple Department of War (DoW) programs. The candidate will ensure compliance through the implementation of mandatory information system security requirements on assigned information systems utilizing various government guidance publications (e.g., NISPOM, DoD 8500 series, NIST, CNSSI, DAAG, etc.) in support of development and operations.

The work that our CCS Professionals do can be summarized in this way:

- You will have a direct impact to national security, ultimately contributing to protecting your loved ones – this is dynamic, gratifying and impactful work!
- You will have the opportunity to engage in all aspects of the cyber discipline within our large organization & portfolio, often getting exposure to many projects
- You will be a part of a company widely recognized as a top employer and ranked #38 on Forbes "2025 World’s Best Employers"

You will have an opportunity to make a difference in your first year by:

- Coordinating and managing interactions with government partners to facilitate and maintain 100% active status of all Authorizations to Operate.
- Overseeing technical administration of information system in accordance with internal LM and customer security requirements, primarily Risk Management Framework (RMF) to include Continuous Monitoring, Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M), and Change Management.
- Developing and implementing government-approved information system security procedures and system security plans for the operation of networked and standalone classified systems.
- Communicating, implementing, and managing a formal cybersecurity program
- Overseeing and conducting risk assessments on cybersecurity architecture and perform comprehensive investigations of computer security incidents, collaborating with outside agencies as required.

Other Key Responsibilities and Challenges of this role include (modify as appropriate for the position):

- Ensure configuration management (CM) for security-relevant software, hardware, and firmware.
- Assist and conduct cybersecurity education and training.
- Assist in conducting investigations of computer security violations and incidents.
- Handling mission requirements which may drive unpredictable work hours/schedules
- Working in a high paced environment driven by growing and ever-changing technical implementation requirements

Basic Qualifications

- Active Secret security clearance.
- DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II certification (e.g., Security+ CE, CySA+, CCNA Security, CND).
- Proven hands on experience with industry standard cybersecurity tools, including vulnerability scanners (e.g., Tenable), Security Incident and Event Management (SIEM) and auditing platforms (e.g., Splunk), endpoint protection solutions (e.g., Trellix), and package submission tools (e.g., eMASS, XACTA)
- Demonstrated ability to lead the Risk Management Framework (RMF) process to secure Authorizations to Operate (ATO), encompassing Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA) authorizations.
- Strong technical root cause analysis skills with a track record of developing corrective actions, policies, and procedures to resolve discrepancies.
- Experience conducting risk and vulnerability assessments in line with applicable regulations, such as the DCSA Assessment and Authorization Guide (DAAG), National Industrial Security Program Operating Manual (NISPOM), NIST Special Publication (SP) 800-53, and various DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs)

Desired Skills

- DoD 8570/8140 IAM Level II certification (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CASP+/SecurityX).
- Proven track record of deploying and integrating complex, multi‑classification technologies across large‑scale, enterprise‑wide environments.
- Network device administration experience to include security best practices and monitoring of firewall, routers, and switches.
- Strong background in Agile and DevSecOps methodologies and associated toolsets (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Docker, Ansible, Git).
- In‑depth knowledge of the NISPOM and the DAAG.
- Familiarity with key security frameworks and guidelines, including the Joint Special Access Program (JSIG) Implementation Guide, CNSSI 1253, and NIST SP 800‑37 (Risk Management Framework)
- Experience with Communications Security (COMSEC)
- Proficient in AI prompting as it applies to this position and practice.

Be More Than You Can Imagine.
At Lockheed Martin Aeronautics, we're taking innovation to the next level. From designing the most advanced air vehicle to designing aircraft that defies gravity, our engineers live on the cutting edge of technology. Never have the opportunities for a technical career been so limitless.

Why Lockheed Martin
At Lockheed Martin Aeronautics we value your unique skills and expertise and we aim to give back continuously by offering a wide variety of benefits and amenities to help our employees live flexible, healthy, and fulfilling lives at and outside of work. Some of our team’s favorite perks include:
• The promotion of Work Life Balance
• A competitive 401k match and bonus
• Comprehensive Benefits including Medical/Dental/Life Insurance

The Challenge:
Crave a challenge that is also rewarding? This is an operational support role to an active fighter unit; you will be responsible for the security and integrity of our systems that keep our jets flying.

• Obtain and maintain Special Access Program clearance required for program access
• This is an operational support role to active fighter units. Administrators must be willing and able to travel for military deployments/detachments for extended periods of time dependent upon operational needs.

Lockheed Martin Aeronautics.
Be More Than You Can Imagine.
At Lockheed Martin Aeronautics, we're taking innovation to the next level. From designing the most advanced air vehicle to designing aircraft that defies gravity, our engineers live on the cutting edge of technology. Never have the opportunities for a technical career been so limitless.

Why Lockheed Martin
At Lockheed Martin Aeronautics we value your unique skills and expertise and we aim to give back continuously by offering a wide variety of benefits and amenities to help our employees live flexible, healthy, and fulfilling lives at and outside of work. Some of our team’s favorite perks include:
• The promotion of Work Life Balance
• A competitive 401k match and bonus
• Comprehensive Benefits including Medical/Dental/Life Insurance
• Long term stability

The Challenge:
Crave a challenge that is also rewarding? This is an operational support role to an active fighter unit; you will be responsible for the security and integrity of our systems that keep our jets flying.

It takes more than steel, advanced electronics and engine thrust to make the F-35 Lightning II, the world's fifth generation fighter, take flight. It is the Autonomic Logistics Information System (ALIS) that gives F-35 Lightning II operators the ability to plan, to maintain, to plan and sustain its systems over the life of the air vehicle. ALIS provides the IT backbone and capabilities to support current and future Warfighters across the U.S. and allied military services.

• This is an operational support role to active fighter units. Administrators must be willing and able to travel for military deployments/detachments for extended periods of time dependent upon operational needs.

As an ALIS Administrator with our F-35 ALIS team partnering with our customer, you will wear many hats; system admin duties, data management duties, network admin duties and mission planning admin duties. • Personal Computer Debrief Software (PCDS) experience

• Virtual Machine Management Service (Hyper-V / VmWare)
• Maintaining/upgrading system hardware and startup/shutdown of rack components
• Applying updates, anti-virus/anti-spyware updates, and patch updates

Lockheed Martin Missiles and Fire Control (LMMFC) Advanced Programs (AP) is seeking a Cyber Program Manager Senior Manager with an entrepreneurial streak who is capable of engaging existing and new Lockheed Martin customers. You will serve as a Program Manager for embedded cyber security assessments, products, and R&D for Lockheed Martin product lines, leading the execution of advanced development programs and investments that support critical national security missions. Your work supports our customers by leading diverse teams to develop, design, test, and integrate solutions that protect platform/weapon systems from increasingly sophisticated threats through the research, development, and delivery of advanced security solutions.

You will be responsible for proactively managing program execution across cost, schedule, technical performance, and contract requirements while ensuring successful delivery of program objectives, customer commitments, and strategic business goals. postings.description:
Standard Job Description

WHAT WE'RE DOING:
Lockheed Martin, Cyber & Intelligence invites you to step up to one of today’s most daunting challenges: the evolving threat of cyber warfare. As a cyber security professional at Lockheed Martin, you’ll protect the networks that our citizens and the world depend upon each minute. Here, you’ll work with cybersecurity experts on the forefront of threat protection and proactive prevention. In this fast-paced, real-world environment, you’ll draw on all your education and experience as well as the resources of Lockheed Martin to keep the threats at bay.

Cyber | Lockheed Martin

THE WORK:
The GG RF Engineer is a critical role responsible for designing, installing, and testing RF systems, with a focus on SATCOM components and devices operating in various frequency bands, including but not limited to S-band, C-band, X-band, Ku-band, and Ka-band. The successful candidate will be working on complex RF system design, installation, and test, and will be required to travel up to 15% worldwide. The RF Design Engineer will be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of our RF systems, from design to deployment, and will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure systems meet user requirements.

RF Design and Installation:
•Design, install, and test RF systems, including SATCOM components and devices, utilizing knowledge of RF principles and system design
•Conduct site surveys, climb antennas, and rack hardware as required, ensuring compliance with safety protocols and regulations
RF Test and Measurement:
•Utilize RF test equipment such as Keyband PNA-X, Fieldfox, Spec-A, Sig-Gen, and O-Scopes to test and measure RF system performance, including spectral analysis, modulation analysis, and bit error rate (BER) testing
•Measure and analyze S-parameters, P1dB, TOI, NF, Phase Noise, and Group Delay, with consideration for the impact of non-linear effects, such as intermodulation distortion and spectral growth
•Familiarity with signal processing techniques, including filtering, amplification, and frequency conversion, as applied to SATCOM signal chains

System Design and Documentation:
•Create system drawings and documentation using AutoCAD or Visio, including block diagrams, schematics, and layout drawings
•Understand and apply link budget analysis, antenna patterns, and G/T measurements, with consideration for the effects of noise, interference, and multipath on system performance

Collaboration:
•Work closely with cross-functional teams, including system architects, and project managers, to ensure systems meet user requirements and are delivered on schedule

WHO WE ARE:
The program performs the analysis, design, development, integration, test and deployment, securing, modernization, and operations and maintenance (O&M) and decommissioning activities of RF and optical capabilities.

WHY JOIN US:
Your Health, Your Wealth, Your Life
Our flexible schedules, competitive pay and comprehensive benefits enable you to live a healthy, fulfilling life at and outside of work. We support our employees, so they can support our mission.

#RMSGG2026 #RMSROC

•Travel up to 25% worldwide

•Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or similar field
•RF test experience with Keysight PNA-X and Fieldfox, including familiarity with RF signal generators, spectrum analyzers, and network analyzers
•Familiarity with RF system design, including SATCOM components and devices, such as amplifiers, filters, and antennas
•Experience with AutoCAD or Visio for system drawings and documentation
•Understanding of antenna analysis, including G/T measurements, STK, antenna patterns, and link budget, with consideration for the effects of antenna pointing errors and polarization mismatch

• Perform systems engineering activities and assist in the preparation of a work product in Technical Process Areas associated with the ISO/IEC 15288.
• Develop and deliver a work product in any of the ISO/IEC 15288 Process Areas.
• Perform analysis of technical alternatives for a project and make preliminary recommendations.

• Perform systems engineering activities and develop and deliver work products of either the ISO/IEC 15288 Agreement or Enterprise Process Areas.
• Assist in developing a new or innovative approach to a technical or engineering issue.

Responsible for applying an interdisciplinary, collaborative approach to plan, design, develop, validate and verify Cyber solutions across the lifecycle. Conduct cyber risk assessment activities including threat modeling, vulnerability analysis and analysis of mitigation solutions. Coordinates and addresses Supply Chain risk management concerns. Develop, evaluate and analyze design constrains, trade-offs and detailed system and security design as they pertain to the Cyber domain. Coordinate with Cyber and system architects and developers to provide oversight in the development of solutions. Conduct cybersecurity test and evaluation of hardware and/or software designs to verify and validate compliance with defined specifications and requirements. Employs cyber security processes, methods, techniques and tools and assure their consistent application. Implements appropriate Assessment and Authorization activities as required by customers.

Basic Qualifications

Current DoD Top Secret SCI with Polygraph required

Twenty (20) years of Systems Engineering experience. Bachelor's degree in a Qualified Engineering field or related discipline. Four (4) years of additional SE experience may be substituted for a bachelor's degree. Or A Master's degree in a Qualified Engineering field and eighteen (18) years of Systems Engineering experience.

Requirements:

• Signals analysis: Digital telecommunications systems to include CEPT, payload data and signals structures
- Processing DMR data using Lopers, and Circuit Raptor

Standard Job Description

The Senior Field Engineer (Simulator Technician) will support the Combat Rescue Helicopter (CRH) Training Systems program at Moody Air Force Base, providing advanced-level maintenance, troubleshooting, and sustainment of Operational Flight Trainer (OFT) and Avionics Desktop Trainer (AVDTT), Landing Gear Parts-Task Trainer (LGPTT), and the Hoist Parts-Task Trainer (HPTT) along with associated subsystems.

- Demonstrated hands-on experience with IT/computer systems, including Windows and/or Linux environments, system administration fundamentals, and basic networking.
- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, schematics, and technical orders.
- Experience using test equipment such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, and signal analyzers.

The Lockheed Martin Next Generation Geospatial (NGG) team is seeking full-time experienced Software Engineers to be part of a team building and supporting the ground software for the NGG OPIR mission. The Relay Software (ReSW) team is building the ground-segment software that will replace the legacy Space-Based Infrared System (SBIRS) with the Next-Generation OPIR mission – capable of detecting fast, dim and highly advanced threats.

In this role, you will collaborate across several teams to support and enhance the world class ground software supporting soon-to-launch space vehicles. The successful candidate will have a passion for learning. You will have experience and/or knowledge of SQL, Angular, Java, Python, and C++. You don’t mind the occasional requirement to support during non-standard business hours and working on high-priority system fixes. You are a US Citizen; this position will require government security clearance prior to starting.

This role will have responsibilities that include:

- Troubleshooting issues reported within our Operations domain.
- Fixing high-priority, high-visibility issues in real time.
- An on-call component – occasionally needing to support 24x7 as issues arise within an expected 40-hour work week.

postings.description:
Job Description

We are looking for a technically strong engineer to support the deployment, integration, operation, and sustainment of mission critical systems in classified environments. This position works at the intersection of OpenShift platform operations, Rundeck based automation, and traditional system administration, while also helping to ensure security compliance requirements are met. The role is hands on and fast paced, requiring solid troubleshooting across compute, network, storage, and platform layers. The engineer will act as a key technical resource during deployments and incidents, coordinating with multiple domains and mission stakeholders. This is an individual contributor position with no direct people management duties. Directly contribute to mission critical space programs. Work with cutting edge container platforms and automation frameworks while building expertise in classified environment operations. Partner with engineers, cyber specialists, network teams, and program stakeholders in a high tempo setting.

Key Responsibilities

- Deploy, configure, and maintain OpenShift clusters inside classified networks. Monitor health, apply updates, and work with mission application teams to keep the platform reliable and available.
- Provide day to day support for Linux and Windows servers (patching, configuration management, troubleshooting, lifecycle upkeep).
- Support the configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of routers, switches, and related network infrastructure to ensure reliable connectivity for platform, system, and mission operations.
- Serve as an escalation point for outages or deployment failures. Perform root cause analysis and restore service quickly while documenting findings.
- Follow established security controls, configuration standards, and accreditation requirements. Assist with audit preparation and remediation.
- Diagnose and resolve issues that span networking, storage, operating systems, and platform services.

Basic Qualifications

- Active Top Secret clearance with the ability to maintain clearance eligibility throughout employment (SCI preferred).
- Certifications such as Security+, RHCSA/RHCE, CISSP, or Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA).
- 3+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, platform operations, or system administration, preferably in enterprise or classified environments.
- Strong Linux and Windows Server administration skills (patching, configuration management, troubleshooting).
- Experience configuring and supporting enterprise network devices, including routers and switches, with the ability to troubleshoot connectivity and network performance issues in operational environments.
- Proven ability to troubleshoot distributed systems across compute, network, and storage layers.
- Experience with security focused tasks: system hardening, compliance checks, audit readiness, and maintaining security controls.
- Effective communication and stakeholder engagement abilities; comfortable working with operations, cybersecurity, networking, and program teams.
- Ability to travel on short notice, up to approximately 25%, in support of deployment and operational activities.

Desired Skills

- Knowledge of enterprise networking (routing, switching, DNS, load balancing) and storage technologies (SAN/NAS, replication, backup/recovery).
- Hands-on experience deploying and operating OpenShift clusters; familiarity with automation tools such as Ansible or Puppet.
- Experience serving as a technical anchor during large-scale deployment events or major operational incidents, providing informal mentorship to engineers.

postings.title: Systems Administrator
postings.description:
The Opportunity:

Eligibility: Applicants must be Australian citizens and be eligible to obtain and maintain an active Australian Government Defence security clearance at the level required for the position.

The System Administrator is responsible for maintaining the reliable operation, performance, and security of multi user computer systems, platforms, and associated technologies. Working closely with network administrators and other technical teams, the role manages user and service accounts, system documentation, software deployments, storage allocation, system optimisation, and backup and recovery processes. The position also provides technical support to users, evaluates technology solutions, and contributes recommendations regarding hardware, software, and infrastructure improvements.

Operating with a high degree of technical autonomy, the System Administrator applies sound judgement to resolve issues, implement solutions, and support technology projects and operational objectives. The role contributes to the development and monitoring of policies, procedures, and standards for the effective use of computing resources, while ensuring systems remain aligned with organisational requirements and service expectations.

About you:

The successful candidate will have demonstrated experience providing systems administration support within a professional ICT environment, with experience supporting enterprise systems and infrastructure. The role requires a solid understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems, virtualisation technologies, networking concepts, security practices, and general infrastructure support.

Experience across the following areas is highly desirable:

- Administration, configuration, and support of virtualised environments, including virtual machines, virtualisation management platforms, and associated infrastructure.
- Supporting server infrastructure, enterprise storage solutions, and backup environments.
- Performing system maintenance, software deployments, configuration changes, and troubleshooting of physical and virtual server environments.
- Administration of enterprise services including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and related domain services.
- Applying security controls and system hardening practices across server and virtualised environments.
- Supporting networking technologies, including virtual networking, switches, firewall solutions, and connectivity troubleshooting.
- Assisting with data centre activities such as equipment installation, rack management, cabling, and hardware lifecycle activities.
- Creating and maintaining technical documentation, procedures, and support guides.
- Using scripting or automation tools to improve administration tasks and operational efficiency.

The role requires strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively with internal stakeholders, customers, and vendors. The successful candidate will demonstrate a customer-focused approach, effective communication skills, and an understanding of cybersecurity responsibilities within an ICT environment.

Qualifications:

Essential

- Tertiary qualifications in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline, and/or equivalent practical experience in systems administration.

Desirable

- Relevant industry certifications or vendor training in areas such as Windows Server, virtualisation technologies (e.g. VMware VCP, Nutanix NCP), Linux administration (e.g. RHCSA), networking, or related technologies.

About Lockheed Martin:

Lockheed Martin is a dynamic organisation, providing stimulating and challenging opportunities with a global team of over 122,000 professionals. We embrace flexibility, so our people can be their best inside and outside of work. As a leader in national security, our innovative and diverse programs create a more secure future for Australia across space, air, land, sea, and cyber domains.

Special Requirements:
Applicants must be eligible to obtain and maintain an Australian Defence Security Clearance and employment may be contingent on the provision of further personal information including citizenship to ensure compliance with international export control legislation and regulations.

Veteran Friendly Workplace:
Veterans are encouraged to apply. We highly value the unique skills and experiences that veterans and transitioning service members can contribute to our team. We are proud to be recognised as a Veteran Friendly Employer by the Australian Government.

Equal Opportunity:
Lockheed Martin Australia supports Equal Employment Opportunity and values diversity in the workplace by creating a place of employment that is, free of unlawful discrimination and is harassment free, fair, ethical, inclusive, and values the contribution of all its employees. By leveraging our employees’ unique talents and experiences, we will deliver innovative, affordable solutions and unparalleled customer value.
As part of our endeavours to increase participation of Indigenous Australians, we welcome applications from all people, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people.
We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are selected for this role, we would be happy to discuss any adjustments that will help you to be successful.

postings.description:
System Installer

WHO WE ARE

Lockheed Martin is a global security and aerospace company that employs approximately 120,000 people worldwide and is principally engaged in the research, design, development, manufacture, integration, and sustainment of advanced technology systems, products, and services. Lockheed Martin (LM) Rotary and Mission Systems (RMS) is looking for engineering professionals to work on the Trusted Security Solutions (TSS) program to engineer Cross-Domain Solution (CDS) products - creating innovative solutions to deliver resilient systems, products, and services to protect our customers' platforms against evolving cyber threats.

WHAT WE’RE DOING

This position is for a Systems Engineer/Installer on the Radiant Mercury (RM) product within the TSS program. RM is the US Navy's premier CDS product and LM has been the prime contractor for over 20 years. RM delivers secure cross-domain solutions to our customers, enabling the controlled transfer of information between different security domains. This role is critical in safeguarding the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of these mission-critical systems.

WHO YOU ARE

As an ideal candidate for this position:

- You will have a strong background on Software development programs, a willingness to learn new technologies, and be able to support all phases of the CDS development, configuration, and deployment process
- You should be a well-rounded production engineer that has experience with hardware, networking, software deployment, and system administration
- You will collaborate closely with project management, systems engineers, systems integration and test engineers as well as software engineers to coordinate various types of tasks
- You should expect to learn necessary skills through hands on experiences and should work well in a team
- You will travel frequently to customer sites and be “the face of the program” to the customer; ensuring system deployments and security evaluations go smoothly

THE WORK

- Ensure cyber security standards are met and implemented through the successful deployment of the RM product to customer sites (installation, integration, accreditation, training, and documentation)
- Perform hardware development, factory buildup, and checkout for the CDS product prior to deployment to site
- Understand customer needs/requirements and develop rule sets to be implemented on the CDS that meet customer needs/requirements
- Assist with infrastructure maintenance tasks as well as provide technical assistance to team members and customers through the program help desk
- Work in an agile development environment on RedHat Linux-based OS and support elements of design/sustainment/development efforts
- Members of the production team are expected to travel at a minimum 50% of the time, with regular travel up to 80% of the time
- Production team members are also expected to be available for emergency trips to support customer operational needs

- Our flexible schedules, competitive pay, and focus on work/life balance enable you to live a healthy, fulfilling life at and outside of work

- LOCATION! Check out our beautiful facility online, search ‘Lockheed Martin Deer Creek Facility in Littleton CO’

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree from an accredited college with 2+ years of professional experience in a related discipline, a Master's degree in a related discipline; or equivalent experience/combined education
- Willingness to support regular travel to customer sites to perform installation, integration, accreditation, training, and documentation tasks
- Experience using Red Hat Enterprise Linux
- Ability to learn necessary skills through hands on experiences
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail; Quick thinker, fast learner/Proactive, problem solver, creative, critical thinking skills.
- Ability to work collaboratively within a team and build consensus among stakeholders
- Ability to obtain a Top Secret clearance

Desired Skills

- Understanding of the systems engineering lifecycle, including principles, processes, and methodologies
- Understanding of requirements elicitation, analysis, and documentation
- Understanding of software design and software/system architecture
- Basic networking knowledge
- Basic Red Hat System Administration knowledge

Standard Job Description

You will be the System Engineer for the Missiles & Fire Control (MFC) Systems team. Our team transforms customer and product requirements into complete, reliable missile‑system solutions, delivering on schedule, within budget and with the highest level of performance and supportability.

What You Will Be Doing

As the System Engineer you will be apart of technical planning, integration, verification and validation activities across the full system lifecycle—from concept and design through fabrication, test, operation and disposal. You will help translate requirements into hardware and software specifications, develop test plans, execute verification events and troubleshoot any anomalies that arise. Your responsibilities will include

- Performing functional, timeline and trade‑study analyses to allocate requirements and define interfaces for hardware and software.
- Generating and executing subsystem‑ and system‑level integration and test procedures, ensuring they meet cost, schedule and risk constraints.
- Preparing test equipment and facilities, coordinating with test labs to support Design Verification Tests (DVT), Environmental Stress Screening (ESS), Electromagnetic Interference (EMI) and Functional Acceptance Test (ATP) events.
- Supporting failure investigations, diagnosing hardware, software or test‑equipment anomalies and driving corrective actions to closure.
- Providing engineering evaluations for redesigns or upgrades to existing missile hardware, assessing impact on performance, cost and schedule.
- Maintaining configuration control and documentation of test results, verification reports and lessons‑learned artifacts.
- Collaborating with cross‑functional teams—systems, software, hardware, test, manufacturing and quality—to ensure seamless integration and compliance with program milestones.

Why Join Us

postings.description:
Standard Job Description

WHAT WE'RE DOING:
Lockheed Martin, Cyber & Intelligence invites you to step up to one of today’s most daunting challenges: the evolving threat of cyber warfare. As a cyber security professional at Lockheed Martin, you’ll protect the networks that our citizens and the world depend upon each minute. Here, you’ll work with cybersecurity experts on the forefront of threat protection and proactive prevention. In this fast-paced, real-world environment, you’ll draw on all your education and experience as well as the resources of Lockheed Martin to keep the threats at bay.

THE WORK:
The GG System Administrator is a senior level role that blends enterprise system administration (Linux & Windows) with full cycle network engineering, including design, deployment, and support of Arista as well as other vendor platforms. The incumbent will drive automation, security, and DevOps best practices while delivering resilient, high performance infrastructure for mission critical workload

System Administration:
• Install, configure, and maintain RHEL/CentOS/Ubuntu/Debian servers and Windows Server 2016/2019/2022 instances.
• Manage users, groups, Active Directory, and local security principals.
• Provision and manage storage (partitioning, LVM, RAID, SMB/NFS shares).
• Perform system hardening, patching, and vulnerability remediation in accordance with DoD STIG/CIS baselines.
• Monitor performance, tune kernel/OS parameters, and troubleshoot services.

Automation and Scripting:
• Develop and maintain Ansible playbooks and roles to automate both Linux and Windows workloads (use of WinRM modules).
• Write Bash, PowerShell, and Python scripts for routine tasks, incident response, and reporting.
• Operate Ansible Tower/AWX for job scheduling, credential management, and audit trails.
• Integrate Git version control workflows for infrastructure as code (IaC).

Network Engineering:
• Design, implement, and troubleshoot enterprise L2/L3 networks (VLANs, routing protocols, QoS, DHCP, DNS).
• Arista Specific: Configure Arista EOS switches, leverage CloudVision for centralized provisioning, and automate via eAPI/Ansible modules.
• Conduct capacity planning, high availability design, and performance tuning (BGP, OSPF, EVPN, VXLAN).
• Implement security controls (ACLs, RADIUS/TACACS+, 802.1X, MACsec) and ensure compliance with DoD requirements.

Security & Compliance
• Enforce DoD 8570 IAT 2 standards; apply DISA STIGs and CIS Benchmarks across hosts and network devices.
• Manage secrets, certificates, and role based access controls (RBAC) for both servers and switches.
• Perform regular audits, vulnerability scans, and remediation tracking.

Collaboration & Communication
• Translate technical concepts into clear business value for stakeholders.
• Provide Tier 3 support and knowledge transfer to Tier 1/2 service teams.
• Document designs, runbooks, and SOPs in Confluence/SharePoint and maintain configuration libraries in Git.

WHO WE ARE:
The program drives bold analysis, visionary design, relentless development, seamless integration, rigorous testing and swift deployment, iron‑clad securing, cutting‑edge modernization, and steadfast operations‑and‑maintenance (O&M) through to decisive decommissioning of RF and optical capabilities.

WHY JOIN US:
Your Health, Your Wealth, Your Life
Our flexible schedules, competitive pay and comprehensive benefits enable you to live a healthy, fulfilling life at and outside of work.
We support our employees, so they can support our mission.

#RMSGG2026 #RMSROC

Cloud Native Technologies:
